config.model_resolution: scripts/design/competitor_models.py:load_model_pair; verify full checkpoint/mapping hashes and require admission.reuse_eligible before execution

request_protocol.selection: all known-target real feedback requests in each unchanged frozen edge window for the same10000 users; V4V5 effective13days, others14days
request_protocol.candidate: actual item_idx from requests_fidelity, one score per request_id
request_protocol.prefix: reuse existing prepared release snapshots; no history regeneration or evaluation request changes
request_protocol.query_time: actual query_timestamp; delta from last retained release-snapshot event
request_protocol.prefix_controls: Parent and Current independently encode the identical frozen prefix; Reuse and corrections read Parent-produced state using Current; all methods share UID, requests and snapshot
request_protocol.label_join: retain raw logits before joining quality.label by request_id restricted to the scored cohort/window; no evaluation labels used for fitting, profiling or budget selection
request_protocol.oov: exclude target_known=false from AUC and retain excluded counts
request_protocol.interpretation: release-snapshot state compatibility; not rolling state migration

metrics.primary: pooled ROC_AUC on identical existing real-feedback requests
metrics.nonpositive_or_small_gap: retain absolute AUC and signed gap; display recovery unavailable when Exact-Reuse <=1e-4
metrics.aggregation: request-weighted pooled ROC_AUC; no averaging of per-user AUCs
metrics.ranking_numerics: rank raw logits directly, preserving AUC order without artificial ties from numerical sigmoid saturation
metrics.retention: retain all four new k values on each of four requested edges; preserve all earlier256-teacher scores

compute.x: incremental compatibility arithmetic relative to common native reading
compute.denominator: one Current Exact cache rebuild for each of the10000 release snapshots; never rebuild per request
compute.numerator: 64 Current teacher caches + source selection + each standalone k ridge fit + full-cache translation of10000 snapshots; common native reads excluded
compute.teacher_cost: charge Current teacher cache construction only; Parent cache is already present and common
compute.fitting_and_profiling: include shared calibration, fitting and interval/head profiling in K
compute.reading: charge correction or extra candidate processing for the actual per-user request counts
compute.snapshot_work: charge translation/replay once per user snapshot as applicable
compute.non_claim: arithmetic accounting is not an end-to-end runtime ratio

quality_windows.coverage: frozen matrix_horizon ends at day300; use all available frozen requests in [287,300)

kv_translate.source_layer_selection: in-sample calibration-only single-source-layer same-head OLS; rank by mean R2 over heads and K/V, then fit final maps from all heads of each selected source layer
kv_translate.teacher_access: first64 users in the unchanged original256 fitting order; independent64-user source-layer selection and ridge fit

canary.reference: same64-user maps evaluated by unchanged full evaluator; compare Reuse and all four translation paths; whole global batch sharding on four GPUs

resources.basis: four existing-model edges; only64-teacher KV calibration plus five new score columns; prior37-path single-edge evaluation108s and256-teacher calibration43s bound expected cost
resources.launch: explicit user request; focused pilot first, direct monitoring when under30minutes

display.individual: light gray lines, distinct per-edge markers
display.mean: red; first clip each edge recovery to[0,100], then equal-weight arithmetic mean per matched configuration
display.mean_x: mean of four corresponding theoretical FLOPs percentages
display.translation_points: all eight(teachers,k) combinations with teachers64/256 andk1..4 sorted by theoretical cost, without best-point selection

scope: frozen admitted6L models, no backbone training
new translation64 fitting and scores only; reuse prepared data and existing anchors
retain original model/experiment/config/raw seals; separate supplemental result directory

model_pairs.interpretation: single_seed_development_chain; V0/V1 historical reuse, V2-V5 trained this round; no Reuse executed

single_seed_development_chain; V0/V1 historical reuse, V2-V5 trained this round; no Reuse executed
single_seed_development_chain; V0/V1 historical reuse, V2-V5 trained this round; no Reuse executed
